label: Kolwezi cobalt mines
note: DR Congo supplied about 73% of the world's mined cobalt in 2025; at Kamilombe about 11,000 people dig it by hand.

label: Salar de Atacama
note: Lithium brine pumped at 1,280 litres per second by SQM's own figures; Lickanantay communities report dried wells.

label: Bayan Obo
note: The world's largest rare-earth mine; about 2,000 tonnes of toxic waste per tonne of rare earths.

label: Kachin rare-earth mines
note: 2,700+ leaching pools counted by satellite in 2022; mined under militia control.

label: Glencore (KCC)
note: Owns 70% of Kamoto Copper Company, a large copper and cobalt producer in Kolwezi.

label: Huayou Cobalt / CDM
note: Chinese refiner whose Congolese subsidiary CDM bought cobalt from artisanal traders, according to Amnesty.

label: SQM
note: One of two lithium producers on the Salar de Atacama; sells refined lithium to battery makers.

label: Chinese rare-earth refiners & magnet makers
note: China Northern Rare Earth (Baotou Steel) holds Bayan Obo; Kachin ore is exported to Chinese magnet manufacturers.

label: ASML
note: The only company that makes extreme-ultraviolet lithography machines, which every advanced chip needs.

label: TSMC
note: Fabricates Nvidia's GPUs and the custom AI chips of all five hyperscalers.

label: SK hynix
note: Main supplier of the high-bandwidth memory stacked on Nvidia's AI processors.

label: Nvidia
note: Designs the GPUs almost every AI data centre on this graph runs on; also an investor in OpenAI.

label: Abilene, Texas (Stargate)
note: First Stargate campus: 2.1 GW planned, on-site gas plants, built by Crusoe, owned by Oracle, used by OpenAI.

label: Memphis (Colossus / Boxtown)
note: xAI's Colossus, built in 122 days with 35 gas turbines photographed before any permit, two miles from Boxtown.

label: New Carlisle, Indiana (Rainier)
note: Amazon's $11 billion campus built exclusively for Anthropic's Claude; 2.2 GW expected demand.

label: West Des Moines, Iowa
note: Microsoft's cluster where GPT-4 was trained; 11.5 million gallons of water in July 2022.

label: The Dalles, Oregon
note: Google's data centres use about a third of the city's water; the city fought for 13 months to keep the figure secret.

label: Phoenix, Arizona (TSMC fab)
note: TSMC's first Arizona fab uses about 1.7 billion gallons of water a year; expansion could make it the city's largest water customer.

label: Sama
note: Labelled toxic text for OpenAI and moderated Facebook for Meta; workers took home under $2 an hour.

label: Teleperformance / Majorel
note: Runs Meta's East African moderation from an unmarked Accra office; base pay about $80 a month.

label: Genpact
note: Ran a 1,600-person Facebook content-review unit; 2,000 posts per eight-hour shift on busy days.

label: Scale AI / Remotasks
note: Data-labelling platform whose Remotasks workers in Nigeria, Kenya and Venezuela were cut off without explanation in 2024.

label: OpenAI
note: Maker of ChatGPT.

label: Anthropic
note: Maker of Claude, the model that helped build this page.

label: Google / Alphabet
note: Maker of Gemini; owns 14% of Anthropic.

label: Meta
note: Maker of Llama; buys moderation from Sama, Teleperformance and Genpact.

label: Microsoft
note: OpenAI's main investor and cloud; the biggest buyer of Nvidia chips in 2024.

label: Amazon (AWS)
note: Anthropic's main investor and training partner.

label: xAI
note: Maker of Grok; runs Colossus in Memphis.

label: Oracle
note: Owns the Abilene Stargate campus and leases its computing power to OpenAI.
